how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-barrens-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:890:obj:0: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
rows.quest:890:details:0: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?
rows.quest:890:details:1: BHere, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
rows.quest:890:completion:0: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.
rows.quest:890:completion:1: BBet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
rows.quest:891:obj:0: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 ⟦E1⟧ Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.
rows.quest:891:details:0: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!
rows.quest:891:details:1: BThose bastards must be dealt with. Their ⟦E2⟧ has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.
rows.quest:891:details:2: BTravel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
rows.quest:891:completion:0: Alas, the righteous ⟦E3⟧ guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:891:completion:1: BNow to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
rows.quest:892:obj:0: Return Gazlowe's Ledger to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
rows.quest:892:details:0: Everything looks square from my records, ⟦2⟧. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.
rows.quest:892:details:1: BNothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
rows.quest:892:completion:0: No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.
rows.quest:892:completion:1: BLooks like I've got some goods to get back, ⟦3⟧. What do you say?
rows.quest:893:obj:0: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:893:details:0: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.
rows.quest:893:details:1: BIf you wish to help bring honor to the ⟦E5⟧, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
rows.quest:893:completion:1: BThe quilboar are further along than I had expected.
rows.quest:893:completion:2: BHere, ⟦4⟧, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
rows.quest:894:obj:0: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site.
rows.quest:894:details:0: The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".
rows.quest:894:details:1: BNow what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.
rows.quest:894:details:2: BI obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
rows.quest:894:completion:0: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
rows.quest:895:obj:0: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
rows.quest:895:details:1: BBaron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless
rows.quest:895:details:2: BCaptain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!
rows.quest:895:completion:0: Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!
rows.quest:895:completion:1: BAnyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
rows.quest:896:obj:0: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers for Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet.
rows.quest:896:details:0: Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.
rows.quest:896:details:1: BThe latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
rows.quest:896:completion:0: Look at the size of that thing, ⟦5⟧! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!
rows.quest:896:completion:1: BNow let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:897:obj:0: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
rows.quest:897:details:0: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:897:completion:0: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the ⟦E4⟧. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...
rows.quest:897:completion:1: BBut for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.
rows.quest:898:obj:0: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.
rows.quest:898:details:1: BI can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from ⟦E1⟧ are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:898:details:2: BMe! A threat to their great sham of an ⟦E3⟧? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.
rows.quest:898:details:3: BEnough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
rows.quest:898:completion:0: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!
rows.quest:898:completion:1: BYour heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:899:obj:0: Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:899:details:0: Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, ⟦8⟧. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.
rows.quest:899:details:2: BKill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
rows.quest:899:completion:0: ⟦10⟧, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.
rows.quest:899:completion:1: BAlthough my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
rows.quest:900:obj:0: Close off the Fuel Control Valve, the Regulator Valve and the Main Control Valve then use the control console again.
rows.quest:900:details:0: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
rows.quest:900:completion:0: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
rows.quest:901:obj:0: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles to use on the control console.
rows.quest:901:details:0: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
rows.quest:901:completion:0: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
rows.quest:902:obj:0: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
rows.quest:902:details:0: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
rows.quest:902:completion:0: This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.
rows.quest:902:completion:1: BBut, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
rows.quest:903:obj:0: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:903:details:0: Now it's time to go after something that really bites. The prowlers of the ⟦E4⟧ are a tough breed. Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly. You'll find them among the tall grasses. You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:903:details:1: BBe wary as you hunt them, ⟦11⟧, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
rows.quest:903:completion:0: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
rows.quest:905:obj:0: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers. Use the feathers on the 3 Scytheclaw nests. Return to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:905:details:0: Now, ⟦12⟧, the hunt deepens. Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.
rows.quest:905:details:1: BHunt the sunscale raptors to the south. Slay them and remove the feathers they wear. Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
rows.quest:905:completion:0: Is your task finished? Ponder the life of the Scytheclaw as you do it. There are important lessons within every creature's lifespawn.
rows.quest:905:completion:1: BSome of the others believe I have been too heavy handed in my lesson. I know that you are simply following my orders, but I want you to consider the life of the creatures you are slaughtering.
rows.quest:905:completion:2: BThough they are at times a nuisance, they only become threatening when we seek their slaughter. This days defilement will cause us more trouble than it will solve problems...
rows.quest:906:obj:0: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:906:details:0: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, ⟦13⟧. ⟦14⟧ He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in ⟦15⟧ such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. ⟦16⟧
rows.quest:906:details:1: BI will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, ⟦17⟧. Until then, farewell.
rows.quest:906:completion:0: You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, ⟦18⟧? Amazing.
rows.quest:906:completion:1: BI am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.
rows.quest:906:completion:2: BI must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:907:obj:0: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:907:details:0: Now, ⟦20⟧, you must face the great thunder lizards. So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains. Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.
rows.quest:907:details:1: BYou will find the thunder lizards in the southern ⟦E4⟧. They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads. Return to me after you have bested them.
rows.quest:907:completion:0: It is good to see you return with proof of victory. And it is good to know you have done so with your bones unbroken.
rows.quest:913:obj:0: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:913:details:0: The thunderhawk, ⟦21⟧, is a fierce beast. It is time for you to face them. You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.
rows.quest:913:details:1: BDo this, and your time with me will near its end.
rows.quest:913:completion:0: You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.
rows.quest:913:completion:1: BBut your path, ⟦22⟧, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.
rows.quest:913:completion:2: BNow, it is time to move on.
rows.quest:1060:obj:0: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1060:details:0: You've done so well for me, ⟦23⟧. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.
rows.quest:1060:details:1: BThe harpies are not from around the ⟦E4⟧. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.
rows.quest:1060:details:2: BHe'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
rows.quest:1060:completion:0: Ahh, a letter from Darsok. I have not heard from him in many years.
rows.quest:1060:completion:1: BSo the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. Ah, to be young again, like you.
rows.quest:1069:obj:0: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1069:details:0: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.
rows.quest:1069:details:2: BIn Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the ⟦E6⟧ to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!
rows.quest:1069:details:3: BIn Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.
rows.quest:1069:details:4: BIn Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
rows.quest:1069:completion:1: BI'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. I can already taste the profits!
rows.quest:1069:completion:2: BHere is your cut, ⟦24⟧. I couldn't have made this deal without you.
rows.quest:1145:obj:0: Deliver Korran's Sealed Note to Belgrom Rockmaul in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1145:details:0: Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.
rows.quest:1145:details:1: BI need a courier to travel to ⟦E7⟧ to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.
rows.quest:1145:details:2: BBelgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.
rows.quest:1145:completion:0: Ah, a note from Korran. He has been a loyal servant for some time now. I was wondering how his duties were going in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1153:obj:0: Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1153:details:0: ⟦25⟧, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.
rows.quest:1153:details:1: BTravelers recently came from the south from a place called ⟦E8⟧. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
rows.quest:1153:completion:0: A good sample, ⟦26⟧. A good sample indeed.
rows.quest:1153:completion:1: BThose travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.
rows.quest:1153:completion:2: BI shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.
rows.quest:1153:completion:3: BI shall not forget your help, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:1483:obj:0: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1483:details:0: The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.
rows.quest:1483:details:1: BA while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the ⟦E6⟧ hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.
rows.quest:1483:details:2: BMaybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1483:completion:0: I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!
rows.quest:1483:completion:1: BHa! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
rows.quest:1492:obj:0: Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1492:details:0: I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.
rows.quest:1492:details:1: BIf you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.
rows.quest:1492:completion:0: A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.
rows.quest:1492:completion:1: BAll taken care of! Good day to you, ⟦28⟧.
rows.quest:3261:obj:0: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:3261:details:0: Your time with me is over, ⟦29⟧. To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer. He will continue your guidance.
rows.quest:3261:completion:0: Greetings, young one. You are here to walk the hunter's path?
rows.quest:3281:obj:0: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:3281:details:0: You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered! I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the ⟦E9⟧ Grounds. It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.
rows.quest:3281:details:1: BGo to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver. When you find it, return it to me.
rows.quest:3281:completion:0: Aha! So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair. It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver. Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!
rows.quest:3281:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦30⟧. Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
rows.quest:3301:obj:0: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:3301:details:0: My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies. Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life. Perhaps the strange life found here in the ⟦E4⟧ can help her work in Silverpine.
rows.quest:3301:details:1: BTake a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine. She is staying at the Sepulcher. With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
rows.quest:3301:completion:0: Ah, what is this? This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life. Amazing! I must study it further.
rows.quest:3301:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦31⟧. With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.
rows.quest:3369:obj:0: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.
rows.quest:3369:details:0: This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.
rows.quest:3369:details:1: BI do not wish to alarm you, ⟦32⟧, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.
rows.quest:3369:details:2: BHamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to ⟦E10⟧. I cannot say more.
rows.quest:3369:completion:0: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...
rows.quest:3369:completion:3: B⟦34⟧, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.
rows.quest:3369:completion:4: BLet's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...
rows.quest:3369:completion:5: BPerhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
rows.quest:3370:obj:0: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:3370:details:0: This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.
rows.quest:3370:details:1: BI do not wish to alarm you, ⟦35⟧, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can...
rows.quest:3370:details:2: BMathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Circle is who you need to find. Head to ⟦E11⟧. I cannot say more.
rows.quest:3370:completion:0: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...
rows.quest:3370:completion:3: B⟦37⟧, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that the Cenarion druids alone must attend to.
rows.quest:3370:completion:4: BLet's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...
rows.quest:3370:completion:5: BPerhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
rows.quest:3513:obj:0: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3513:details:0: The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?
rows.quest:3513:details:1: BThere is an outpost close to the ⟦E12⟧ border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
rows.quest:3513:completion:0: Well now... Where did you find this?
rows.quest:3514:obj:0: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.
rows.quest:3514:details:0: This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.
rows.quest:3514:details:1: BShe'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The ⟦E5⟧ will not tolerate her outrunners here.
rows.quest:3514:details:2: B⟦38⟧, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this ⟦E5⟧ flag, ⟦39⟧. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.
rows.quest:3514:completion:0: You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, ⟦40⟧. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less ⟦E3⟧ runners in the ⟦E4⟧. They will think again before sending another this way.
rows.quest:3921:obj:0: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.
rows.quest:3921:details:0: I think I might have broken that Samophlange. That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued. We must find a way to fix it!
rows.quest:3921:details:1: BTake the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E12⟧. She is very clever and inquisitive. If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.
rows.quest:3921:completion:0: Oh, what's this? A samophlange, you say? What's a samophlange??
rows.quest:3921:completion:1: BAh... but look at the way it moves when you handle it. And there's the sound of intricate gears inside. Oh my! I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
rows.quest:3922:obj:0: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3922:details:0: I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies. I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.
rows.quest:3922:details:1: BThe closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east. The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets. Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.
rows.quest:3922:completion:0: Great, you got them! Now I can get to work...
rows.quest:3923:obj:0: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3923:details:0: Well, that didn't work. I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low. I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.
rows.quest:3923:details:1: BYou should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob. He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.
rows.quest:3923:details:2: BYou can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in ⟦E7⟧, in the Valley of Honor.
rows.quest:3923:completion:0: What's this? Why, it's a samophlange! Where did you get this thing? Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the ⟦E4⟧?
rows.quest:3923:completion:1: BYou must be very brave, or very stupid.
rows.quest:3924:obj:0: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3924:details:0: I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first. When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted. I wasn't one of the trusted few...
rows.quest:3924:details:1: BBoss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern ⟦E4⟧. Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.
rows.quest:3924:completion:0: You got the manual! I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange! I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.
rows.quest:3924:completion:1: BI want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
rows.quest:4021:obj:0: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:4021:details:0: The ⟦E5⟧ commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened. I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the ⟦E4⟧ from their home in ⟦E13⟧, to seek vengeance. My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!
rows.quest:4021:details:1: BFace the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the ⟦E4⟧. Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears. Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.
rows.quest:4021:completion:0: You have done it! You have defeated the Kolkar!
rows.quest:4021:completion:1: BI will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, ⟦42⟧.
rows.quest:4021:completion:2: BStand tall. You do yourself, and the ⟦E5⟧, proud.
rows.quest:4921:obj:0: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:4921:details:0: We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.
rows.quest:4921:details:1: BI awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.
rows.quest:4921:details:2: BPlease, ⟦43⟧, find some sign of my wife.
rows.quest:5041:obj:0: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5041:details:0: That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.
rows.quest:5041:details:1: BYou've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.
rows.quest:5041:details:2: BThe people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
rows.quest:5041:completion:0: Haha! Thank you, ⟦45⟧! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the ⟦E5⟧. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
rows.quest:5052:obj:0: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5052:obj:1: BCollect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.
rows.quest:5052:details:0: Along with the thorns, the blood affected ⟦46⟧ other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems ⟦47⟧ for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. ⟦48⟧
rows.quest:5052:details:1: BI know the secrets of that magic.
rows.quest:5052:details:2: BBring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! ⟦49⟧
rows.quest:5052:completion:0: Ah, you do understand. ⟦50⟧ My words were not lost on your ears, ⟦51⟧. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! ⟦52⟧
rows.quest:5052:completion:1: BThe touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, ⟦53⟧.
rows.quest:5052:completion:2: BDo you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?
rows.quest:5052:completion:3: BBut, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them. ⟦54⟧
rows.quest:6361:obj:0: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:6361:details:0: I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the ⟦E4⟧, and must get them to ⟦E10⟧. A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.
rows.quest:6361:details:1: BWill you take the hides to him for me?
rows.quest:6361:details:2: BThe quickest way to ⟦E10⟧ is on the back of a wind rider. Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:6361:completion:0: If you must take these hides to ⟦E10⟧, then you are speaking to the right orc!
